name: Example: Computing a Differential in a Geometrical Context
problem: Given a cone, find the differential $\textrm d V$ for the volume $V$ of the cone if the radius is $r=6$ and the height is $h = 3.$
worked_solution:
The volume of the cone is $V = \dfrac{1}{3} \pi r^2h.$ Let's find the differential:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{d}V(r,h) & =(\frac{∂V}{∂r})\,\text{d}r+(\frac{∂V}{∂h})\,\text{d}h \\  & =\frac{2}{3}\pi rh\,\text{d}r+\frac{1}{3}\pi {r}^{2}\,\text{d}h.\end{aligned}
$$

For $r=6$ and $h=3,$ the differential is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{d}V(6,3) & =\frac{2}{3}\pi \cdot 6\cdot 3\,\text{d}r+\frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot {6}^{2}\,\text{d}h \\  & =12\pi \,\text{d}r+12\pi \,\text{d}h.\end{aligned}
$$
